chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said regarding the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
"There is no good in much of their secret conversation except for one who enjoins charity or kindness or reconciliation between people."

key_terms.صَدَقَةٍ: charity given for the benefit of others
key_terms.مَعْرُوفٍ: recognized good; here explained as lending

ai.seo_question: What does الْمَعْرُوفُ mean in Qur'an 4:114 according to Imam عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This narration explains the Qur'anic term الْمَعْرُوفُ in this verse as referring to lending. It highlights that giving a loan is a praiseworthy social good included among the acts that bring real benefit in people's private dealings.
